name: Copy Button
description: A value (install command, API key, link) with a copy action. The icon morphs to a check and the label to Copied; if the clipboard is blocked it falls back to the older copy command, and if that fails too it selects the text, says Press ⌘C and calls onError.
intents: share link with a copy button
usage: Use next to anything people paste elsewhere: commands, keys, invite links, coupon codes. Pass `value` (what is shown and copied); add `text` when the copied string differs from what is shown (a masked key). `onCopy(text)` fires after a successful copy, `onError(error, text)` when the clipboard refused. Keep the value visible so people can check what they copied; with `showValue={false}` and `showLabel={false}` it becomes an icon button whose accessible name is "Copy <value>". With no value it renders a disabled Copy button.

keyboard.does: Copies the text; the label turns to Copied, or to Press ⌘C with the value selected when the clipboard is blocked, and goes back after `resetAfter`.

screenReader: A native button named by its text (`label`, "Copy" by default), or by `label` plus the value when `showLabel` is off. A polite live region says "Copied to clipboard" after a copy, or that the copy failed and the text is selected for a manual copy, and empties when the button goes back.

dataProps.description: What is shown, and copied unless `text` is set.
What is copied when it should differ from `value` (show "sk_live_…a91d", copy the full key).
A dim prefix before the value, such as "$" for a shell command. Not copied.
Button label before copying; also the start of the icon-only accessible name.
Button label after a successful copy.
Button label when copying failed. Defaults to "Press ⌘C" ("Press Ctrl+C" off Apple devices) when the value is visible and selected for a manual copy, otherwise "Copy failed".
(text) => void. Called after the text is on the clipboard.
(error, text) => void. Called when neither the Clipboard API nor the fallback could copy.
Native disabled on the button. It is also disabled when there is nothing to copy.
Other attributes (aria-label, aria-describedby, data-*, title) go to the copy <button>; className and style go to the root.

example:
<CopyButton
  value={inviteUrl}
  onCopy={() => track("invite_copied")}
  onError={() => toast.error("Couldn't copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.")}
/>

<CopyButton value="sk_live_…a91d" text={apiKey} prompt="key" />
